purpose: Reserve one paid immediate-upgrade checkout for an existing Subscription and apply the higher immutable plan version only after the referenced D1-04 Order and Payment are confirmed through the signed Hyperswitch webhook path.

states.meaning: D1-04 upgrade Order exists and the exact current Subscription CAS identity is reserved; payment_id is null.
The signed successful Hyperswitch webhook has been verified and the matching D1-04 payment_id is attached; the same-cycle Subscription CAS may be completed or retried.
The existing Subscription now uses the target plan/version and its current paid billing period remains unchanged.

transitions.guard: Verified successful Hyperswitch webhook; D1-04 Payment succeeded; D1-04 Order confirmed; paid amount and currency equal the authoritative order total; exact reservation identity matches; payment_id was previously null.
effects: Attach the exact D1-04 payment_id once
Do not change Subscription plan or entitlements yet

transitions.guard: Subscription remains ACTIVE and uncanceled; source plan/version, subscriber, subscription version and current period exactly match the reserved snapshot; target is the higher immutable same-creator, same-currency and same-interval plan version.
effects: CAS update plan_id and plan_version on the existing Subscription
After-update trigger marks the application APPLIED
Do not create a second Subscription

invariants: At most one PENDING_PAYMENT or READY upgrade reservation exists per Subscription.
A D1-04 Order without a matching PENDING_PAYMENT D1-01 reservation cannot start a Hyperswitch PaymentIntent.
No upgrade entitlement becomes effective before a verified successful payment.
D1-01 stores subscription transition evidence only; Order, Payment, amount and currency remain authoritative in D1-04.
A READY application may retry the subscription CAS after a transient version race without reattaching or replacing the payment_id.
APPLIED is terminal and duplicate signed webhook delivery is idempotent.
forbiddenTransitions: Direct Subscription plan_id/plan_version mutation without a matching READY application or a paid scheduled-period transition
